title: The interview, not shown
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Wednesday. The school-paper interview. The strip goes to the newsroom door and no further: the Timberline's office, the same door, a kid's voice through it asking a question the strip doesn't print. Four panels of a door.

panels.composition: A school corridor. The newsroom door: THE TIMBERLINE, stenciled, the same stencil. WOOD outside it, in the chore coat, a visitor's badge.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a graying man in a canvas chore coat wearing a visitor's badge standing outside a school newsroom door with a stenciled name
image.notes: Letter after: THE TIMBERLINE on the door. VISITOR on the badge.

panels.composition: The door, closed. From inside, a balloon leaking under it — the kid's question — drawn as a balloon with its text cut off by the door.
props: a balloon cut by the door

balloons.text: — so when you started, did you —

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a closed door with a speech balloon emerging from beneath it, its text cut off by the door's edge

panels.composition: The door. Wood's balloon, inside now, also cut. The strip refuses both halves.
props: a balloon cut by the door

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a closed school door with a second speech balloon cut off by its edge

panels.composition: The door opening. Wood coming out. The KID behind him in the doorway with a notebook, seventeen, the napkin in his shirt pocket. Neither balloon shown. The corridor.

characters.pose: in the doorway, notebook, a napkin in his pocket

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a graying man coming out of a school newsroom door with a seventeen-year-old boy holding a notebook behind him in the doorway, a napkin in the boy's shirt pocket, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: Four panels of a door. Both balloons cut.
